# 17 Implementation ledger

Flat inventory of every verified implementation finding (`WD-IMPL-*`): 1590 entries. Machine-friendly: one line per entry, fields separated by ` | `, escaped pipes. Lossless JSON companion: `17-IMPLEMENTATION-LEDGER.jsonl` (same ids, all fields, including kind-specific AI/STATE/INV fields). `WD-IDEA-*` ids always refer to the product-knowledge corpus and appear only in the last column as relations from the late coverage check (EXACT_MATCH, PARTIAL_MATCH, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, CONTRADICTED_BY_CODE, UNKNOWN). `WD-IMPL-*` ids are evidence from code.

Line format: `ID | reporter | flags (P=present R=reachable F=functional S=persisted T=tested) | labels | title | summary | evidence | related impl ids | related idea relations | correction`.

Reporter codes: V1..V10 vertical slices (shell, style/library, narrative, streamline, project assets, scene assets, continuity/locations, shots, prompts/frames, video/checkout), C database, E AI registry, H state/invalidation, I infrastructure, J tests, K dead code, L pressure, R1a/R1b contradiction verification, M lead additions, PKn product-knowledge coverage facts.

Retired duplicate ids (AI entries folded into a canonical call): 27. Map: `WD-IMPL-AI-0013->WD-IMPL-AI-0068, WD-IMPL-AI-0016->WD-IMPL-AI-0069, WD-IMPL-AI-0018->WD-IMPL-AI-0069, WD-IMPL-AI-0019->WD-IMPL-AI-0070, WD-IMPL-AI-0020->WD-IMPL-AI-0070, WD-IMPL-AI-0049->WD-IMPL-AI-0035, WD-IMPL-AI-0050->WD-IMPL-AI-0036, WD-IMPL-AI-0065->WD-IMPL-AI-0012, WD-IMPL-AI-0044->WD-IMPL-AI-0024, WD-IMPL-AI-0045->WD-IMPL-AI-0025, WD-IMPL-AI-0043->WD-IMPL-AI-0075, WD-IMPL-AI-0046->WD-IMPL-AI-0076, WD-IMPL-AI-0047->WD-IMPL-AI-0077, WD-IMPL-AI-0055->WD-IMPL-AI-0071, WD-IMPL-AI-0056->WD-IMPL-AI-0073, WD-IMPL-AI-0057->WD-IMPL-AI-0074, WD-IMPL-AI-0058->WD-IMPL-AI-0006, WD-IMPL-AI-0060->WD-IMPL-AI-0007, WD-IMPL-AI-0061->WD-IMPL-AI-0008, WD-IMPL-AI-0053->WD-IMPL-AI-0008, WD-IMPL-AI-0059->WD-IMPL-AI-0009, WD-IMPL-AI-0062->WD-IMPL-AI-0078, WD-IMPL-AI-0063->WD-IMPL-AI-0010, WD-IMPL-AI-0064->WD-IMPL-AI-0011, WD-IMPL-AI-0041->WD-IMPL-AI-0082, WD-IMPL-AI-0052->WD-IMPL-AI-0084, WD-IMPL-AI-0066->WD-IMPL-AI-0080`.
